descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S10 PHI exit path × channel: no email or mailto on any screen that shows patient data, both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 No email or mailto that carries patient data, on any screen that shows patient data, in Hospital and in Nursing Home: no PHI is transmitted through an unencrypted path. … (UAT OAT-02 step 3; UAT OAT-02; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Local stack and a fixture Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, with no note generated. Lane A covers the Hospital handoff and both task reviews (S11, S12); this case covers the remaining cells.

When The agent opens Hospital Post-Round, Settings (About), Nursing Home Post-Round, the Nursing Home Handoff sheet and the Handoffs inbox. It presses no Generate, Send or Delete. Opening Handoff makes one handoff-summary AI call per In Today resident on the local stack.

Then Table: in-app send = allowed; clipboard = allowed (Q7); email, mailto, SMS, the system share sheet, download or print carrying patient data = never (print and download per Q7). No screen with patient data has an email, share, SMS, download or print control. The only mailto (Contact support) carries no subject or body. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint (case-insensitive substring). The patient screens mustNotContain 'mailto:', 'Email', 'sms:' and the role-qualified names 'button "Share', 'link "Share', 'button "Download', 'link "Download' and 'button "Print'. These are matched as accessible names, not bare words, so a generated handoff that says 'shared' or 'printed' cannot false-Fail. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
